supersededCloudRunRoleGuidance.reason: Later owner prerequisite audits proved Cloud Run deploy permissions pass, so roles/run.admin is no longer part of the active owner remediation set.

requiredOwnerActions.purpose: Allow the deployer identity to validate and push the staging API image to the exact staging repository.
Create or select a dedicated staging API runtime service account before Cloud Run deploy.
requiredOwnerActions.commandTemplate: gcloud iam service-accounts create reeditpro-api-staging --project=reeditpro --display-name='ReEditPro API staging runtime'

requiredOwnerActions.purpose: Allow the deployer identity to deploy Cloud Run using the staging API runtime service account.
Allow the deployer identity to describe only the fixed staging API Secret Manager entries without secret payload access.
requiredOwnerActions.commandTemplate: for secret in <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-1> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-2> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-3> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-4>; do gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding "$secret" --project=reeditpro --member=serviceAccount:<repo-configured-gcp-service-account> --role=roles/secretmanager.viewer; done

requiredOwnerActions.purpose: Allow the staging API runtime service account to read only the fixed Secret Manager secrets bound by the guarded deploy workflow.
requiredOwnerActions.commandTemplate: for secret in <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-1> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-2> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-3> <fixed-staging-api-secret-name-4>; do gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding "$secret" --project=reeditpro --member=serviceAccount:reeditpro-api-staging@reeditpro.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor; done

postRemediationValidation: gh workflow run beta-readiness-api-staging-input-discovery.yml --repo yuzastudio6-cyber/Reedkt --ref codex/reeditpro-web-ui-shell --field confirm_staging_api_input_discovery=READ_STAGING_BETA_API_DEPLOY_INPUTS --field artifact_region=us-central1 --field artifact_repository=reeditpro-staging-workers --field deployer_service_account=<repo-configured-gcp-service-account> --field runtime_service_account=reeditpro-api-staging@reeditpro.iam.gserviceaccount.com --field service_name=reeditpro-api-staging
only after exact validation passes, dispatch beta-readiness-api-staging-deploy.yml with an immutable image tag and matching source SHA
